Ingredients:
• 2 1/2 cups plain all-purpose flour
• 1/4 cup plant-based milk (such as almond or soy)
• 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
• 1 teaspoon salt
• 1 teaspoon sugar
• Water, for dipping pretzels in
• Oil, for frying

For the dumplings:
• 1 large onion, finely chopped
• 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped
• 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
• 1 teaspoon ground coriander
• 1 teaspoon ground cumin
• 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
• 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
• 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
• Zest of one lemon
• Salt, for seasoning
• Cooking oil for frying

Instructions:

1. In a small bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and water until a dough forms. Cover and set aside.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the onion, garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom, lemon zest, and salt. Drain any excess water from the flour dough and mix thoroughly.
3. Add half of the onion and garlic mixture to the flour and stir to combine. Slowly beat in the milk and continue to mix to form a soft dough.
4. Turn out the dough onto a floured surface and knead for a few minutes, or until it comes together.
5. Roll the dough out to 1/8-inch thickness and cut into rounds. Using a fork, cut a small cross in the center, creating two holes.
6. In a large bowl, mix together the dumplings and oil.
7. Heat a large skillet (or deep-fryer) over medium-high heat and drop two or three dumplings, 2 inches apart, into the oil. Fry for about one to two minutes, until golden brown.
8. Remove the dumplings with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain. Fill the skillet with the remaining dumplings and fry for another two to three minutes, until golden brown.
9. Serve hot with garlic lemon sauce, tomato sauce, or any other sauce of your choice.
